messages.language.label: Language
messages.content.portuguese_only: The Compliance Day 2026 test content is currently available only in Portuguese (Brazil). The interface language does not change questions, answers, evidence, or pedagogical feedback yet.
messages.privacy.title: Privacy Notice · Compliance Day 2026
messages.privacy.lead: This notice explains how your personal data is processed to operate the Compliance Challenge 2026.
messages.privacy.data.title: Data processed
messages.privacy.data.body: Corporate identification (name, employee/ID number or email and site), authentication, participation, answers, progress, scores, decision time, ranking, achievements, and security and audit records.
messages.privacy.purpose.title: Why we use it
messages.privacy.purpose.body: To control access, provide the training, track completion, operate gamification and ranking, protect the tool, and maintain records needed to administer and audit the program.
messages.privacy.gamification.title: Scores and ranking
messages.privacy.gamification.body: In this tool, scores, ranking and achievements are used for educational and Compliance Day gamification purposes. They are not a professional performance evaluation or disciplinary criterion.
messages.privacy.access.title: Who can access
messages.privacy.access.body: Administrative access follows role and need-to-know rules. Site Administrators see only their own site; the Super Admin has a global view. Rankings shown to participants use masked identification.
messages.privacy.retention.title: Retention
messages.privacy.retention.body: Records are kept for the period needed to administer and evidence the program, meet applicable obligations, and follow corporate retention policies. When no longer needed, deletion or permitted retention follows the LGPD and LG policies.
messages.privacy.rights.title: Your rights
messages.privacy.rights.body: You may exercise rights provided by the LGPD when applicable, including confirmation, access, correction and objection in the cases provided by law. Questions and requests may be sent to LG’s Privacy/DPO channel.
messages.privacy.controller.title: Controller and contact
messages.privacy.controller.body: LG Electronics do Brasil Ltda. · Data Protection Officer (DPO):
messages.privacy.ack.note: By clicking Continue, we only record that this notice was presented and that you acknowledged it. This does not constitute consent to the processing of personal data.
messages.guide.title: How to complete the Compliance Challenge
messages.guide.lead: The journey is simple: read, decide, confirm, and move forward. Review the flow before you begin.
messages.guide.step1.title: Enter the available stage
messages.guide.step1.body: On the portal, use CONTINUE THE ASCENT. Each stage has 10 missions and completed progress is saved.
messages.guide.step2.title: Read the situation and instruction
messages.guide.step2.body: Each mission explains what to do. Depending on the activity, you may select an option, click a scene, order steps, or record more than one decision.
messages.guide.step3.title: Record your answer
messages.guide.step3.body: After selecting your decision, use the button shown on screen. In missions with several decisions, record each one before the final confirmation button.
messages.guide.step4.title: Read the feedback and continue
messages.guide.step4.body: After confirming, you will see the result, explanation, and points earned. Use GOT IT · CONTINUE to move to the next mission.
messages.guide.step5.title: If you need to leave, use Exit
messages.guide.step5.body: Completed missions remain saved. An answer that has not yet been confirmed may need to be entered again when you return.
messages.guide.tip: Tip: use the portal to follow your progress, ranking, and achievements. Detective, Camp Roulettes, and the Collective Challenge appear under Extra Activities when available.
